text:
```yaml
name: Link Checker

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]

jobs:
  lychee:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Link Checker
        uses: lycheeverse/lychee-action@v2
        with:
          args: |
            --verbose
            --format github
            --fail
            README.md
            CONTRIBUTING.md
            SECURITY.md
            CHANGELOG.md
            RELEASES.md
            CLAUDE.md
            docs/**/*.md
            examples/**/*.md
            tests/**/*.md
            docker/**/*.md
            bin/**/*.md
            crates/**/*.md
```
